featured_reviews.name: Nandita kenia
featured_reviews.review_text:
While at school always though of becoming an artist. Dream became reality when I joined   Rajaram Fine Art Insititute in Matunga. Thank you Sri Krishna Sir for guiding me to take up art as my career.
Started as a student, worked as him assistant, started my own classes & today successful glass artist running a art glass business.
Thank you Sir 🙏.

featured_reviews.name: Sachindra Puthran
featured_reviews.review_text: As a Microbiologist, I never dreamt of becoming an artist. But thanks to Rajaram Fine Art Insititute in Ghatkopar and Matunga that enabled me to become an inspired artist. It all started as a hobby, but today after 30 years, i have become a successful professional in Design and Communication Ideas. Thanks to Sri Krishna Sir for his love and passion for teaching students like me and see us rise from bottom to top. There are thousand of students like me who have built their life from this class. I strongly recommend all beginners to learn under the talented teachers in art and drawing. Bring that artist out and show the world your real talent.

featured_reviews.name: Vikrant Karia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajaram Fine Art Insititute. it's one of pioneer  Institute for fine arts  in Mubmai (Ghatkopar and Matunga)which is training students from  last more than 70 years.and Legacy is still continued
Rajaram Fine Art Institute, provide quality art education to aspiring artists. Institute offers various courses in painting, sketching, for the needs of students with different levels of expertise.
And not just aspiring artist but for those children who join institute just as a hobby and then inspired to persue art as a career.

In 1979-80 one of my relative who was  ex-student  of Rajaram sir saw the flair of art in me and suggested  me to join  Matunga  branch.
Than I came in contact with Shrikishna sir, who  started his Branch at Ghatkopar & here I started  to learnt all the  mediums of art  & realistic  work. under  my Guru Shri krishna sir & this  helped me a lot in  my Art graduation at G D art  Drawing and Painting.
During my  art course in academic period of 1981 to 1986, at Raheja school of art time, I started assisting sir. ( morning hours & full time in vacation .)
After finishing my GD art painting course in 1986, I started assisting sir for full  time  till 1992.
In 1987 we started  Entrance  test courses for BFA & Architecture at Rajaram class.
This was the  turning point of my career.
During this time many students were joining class for hobby & than came to know that they can choose  art as a career & than they made susscsessful art career in different various fields.
An that's why  I always mention that,
"We design  your art career"
Now the 3rd  generation
(Rajaram sir, Srikrishna sir & now Shyam and Shreya.)
have  continuined   devloping the art skill  in  children of any age.
With the  sir's blessings  I am running my own  Institute from more than 35 years Under the banner "Vikrant Karia Institute of Art"  at Ghatkopar.
As an artist and an educator, I look forward to continuing the legacy of Rajaram Fine Art Institute and inspiring more and more individuals to pursue their passion for art.

featured_reviews.name: Anshul Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have worked with Jaywanti Mam at Arty Mélange as our daughter Asahi's arts teacher for the past five years, and it has been truly transformative for her journey toward studying industrial design abroad. Beyond building strong foundational skills in her early years, Jaywanti Mam expertly guided Aashi in creating a standout portfolio for competitive universities like RISD, Pratt Institute, Parsons School of Design, UAL, and SCAD—securing admissions with scholarships at Pratt, Parsons, and SCAD.

What sets Jaywanti Mam apart is her deep knowledge of each school's unique expectations. Her step-by-step coaching turned Asahi's ideas into professional-grade work, complete with artist statements and renders tailored for admissions. Feedback was always honest, constructive, and grounded in real-world industry standards, helping avoid pitfalls like generic designs or weak narratives. Jaywanti Mam is now a recognized name at SCAD, with many of her students thriving there.

Even online sessions were flexible, engaging, and resource-rich (software tips, mock reviews, peer critiques). This prep gave Aashi a huge edge for industrial and product design careers. If you're targeting top art/design programs abroad, Arty Mélange with Jaywanti Mam is the real deal—highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Kritvi Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joined for giving design entrances like NID and UCEED very last minute with only a few months to go before the exams, but Jaywanti ma'am was extremely helpful. She helped make a customized schedule to catch me up with the preparation alongside the normal classes, and was always available for feedback and advice. She does not overlook any student, and gives everyone personalised attention according to their needs and level. The classes prepare you for the theory part of entrances as well as the practical drawing section.

She rehearses and goes through everything that will help students before the exams; common types of questions for each specific exam, tips for performing under time, what each institute is looking for, common mistakes students make, how to be more efficient in your drawings etc. She helps you tranform your skill into a way you can display it in entrances. I don't think just any other teacher would have helped me prepare so thoroughly and in such a short period of time, which is what allowed me to perform well in design entrances. I highly recommend her classes for anyone who wants to push themself with a different medium, or to explore/ learn anything new in art.

featured_reviews.name: Manas Prabhutendolkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Needed help with my portfolio for my Master's application to various universities in EU. It was a great learning experience and my portfolio was completely transformed with ma'ams guidance. With her help, I managed to secure admission to the Design Academy Eindhoven for the Critical Inquiry Lab MA Program. Would highly recommend her teaching to everyone.

Her dedication and belief in her students helped my daughter score a perfect 100 in the Class 10 Art paper, with an outstanding portfolio to match. She is now preparing for design entrance exams with Ma’am’s continued support. I highly recommend Jaywanti Ma’am to anyone seeking a sincere, passionate, and results-driven mentor.

Jaywanti Ma'am was my mentor in art since I was a little girl. She played a huge role in my interest towards art and drawing in general as well as in developing my passion for design.

When the time came for college entrance preparations there was no other choice for me but to go to Artymelange. She was a great help in all the design entrance exams with her invaluable insight. I was able to clear all kinds of entrance exams, both private and government solely due to her guidance. I ultimately took admission in NIFT Kolkata with a lot of help and advice from Ma'am.

Jaywanti Ma'am not only prepares us for the entrance examinations but also for college life itself. The things that she taught us were the topics that were covered during our first year. This put me in a very advantageous position and made my first year of college education a lot easier.

Joining Artymelange was the best decision of my life and I would highly recommend it.
